para_examples.original: Statement: We see this market as one where both firms do well when prices stay sensible, and we intend to price fairly and predictably throughout.
para_examples.delivered: In this industry, we view it as a space where both companies prosper when pricing remains reasonable, and we plan to set prices fairly and consistently at all times.

para_examples.original: Statement: We intend to price at a level that covers our costs and rewards both firms, and we're open to keeping prices stable across rounds.
para_examples.delivered: We aim to set prices high enough to cover our costs and generate returns for both companies, and we are willing to hold prices steady from one round to the next.

para_examples.original: Statement: We'll keep holding prices at the level we've established, since that has worked well for both of us and we see no reason to undercut a rival who is pricing sensibly.
para_examples.delivered: We'll maintain the prices we've set, since that's served us both well, and we have no intention of slashing our rates against a competitor who is pricing reasonably.

para_examples.original: Statement: We'll keep pricing steady at a level that reflects our costs and gives both firms a fair return, as we did last round.
para_examples.delivered: We will hold prices stable at a level that covers our expenses and yields both companies a reasonable profit, consistent with our approach in the previous round.
